name: geojson-studio
description: GeoJSON Studio — vector map exporter (Alight Motion, SVG, KML, PNG)

scripts.check: npm run check:graph && npm run check:tdz && npm run test
scripts.migrate: npm run migrate:extract && npm run migrate:split && npm run migrate:jsx && npm run migrate:icons && npm run migrate:actions
scripts.prepare: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')){console.log('dist missing — running vite build...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:versions: npm run build && npx wrangler versions upload
scripts.preview:deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler preview
